In the thick ascending limb, it is reabsorbed via the Na+/K+2Cl- symporter in the apical membrane and by paracellular diffusion in the space between the cells. In the DCT, it is reabsorbed via the type 1 (principal) and type 2 (intercalated) cells. It is reabsorbed through the NCC (Na+/Cl- co-transporter) in the apical membrane and the ROMK (Renal outer Medullary K+) in the basolateral membrane.
